description: This file defines internal spinlock wait operations for the Abseil C++ library, including structures and functions for atomic transitions, waiting, waking, and delaying spinlocks, as well as external C linkage functions.

classes.name: SpinLockWaitTransition
classes.description: Structure representing a transition from one state to another in spinlock wait operations.

methods.name: SpinLockWait
methods.description: Waits until a spinlock can perform one of several state transitions.

methods.name: SpinLockWake
methods.description: Wakes threads waiting on a spinlock, optionally all threads.

methods.name: SpinLockDelay
methods.description: Delays spinlock retries, possibly yielding or sleeping based on system conditions.

methods.name: SpinLockSuggestedDelayNS
methods.description: Provides a suggested delay in nanoseconds for spinlock backoff.
